channel.title: Crypto Front Page
channel.description: Crypto Front Page reports news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, stablecoins, exchanges, DeFi protocols, regulation and network upgrades across the crypto industry.

item.title: Arbitrum to Ethereum: official bridge or fast bridge?
item.description: For an Arbitrum to Ethereum withdrawal, a fast bridge usually wins on time; the official bridge fits large amounts when waiting about a week is acceptable.

item.title: How to Respond After a Fake Site Drains Your Wallet
item.description: My wallet was drained after approving a fake site. Find out whether you approved a token allowance or exposed your seed, then protect what remains and report the theft.

item.title: Yield optimizer vs aggregator: who picks the protocol?
item.description: Yield optimizer vs yield aggregator: an optimizer compounds rewards in one strategy; an aggregator allocates across protocols, often choosing where your deposit goes.

item.title: Curated lending vault vs single market: choose your route
item.description: Curated lending vault vs lending to a single market directly: a vault spreads and rebalances funds for a fee; direct lending keeps one market under your control.

item.title: How can I finalize a Base withdrawal at low gas?
item.description: To finalize a Base withdrawal when Ethereum gas is low, time prove and finalize for a low base fee, then cap each transaction’s max fee in your wallet.

item.title: Why bridged tokens hide behind the wrong network
item.description: Tokens not showing in your wallet after bridging to layer 2? Switch networks, check the L2 explorer, and import the token using its destination contract.

item.title: DOJ files to forfeit $1.1 billion in Binance-linked USDC
item.description: The Justice Department filed to forfeit $1.1 billion in USDC tied to Binance’s October theft, putting the frozen tokens on a path toward a court decision.

item.title: EIP-1559 Fee Caps and the Gas Price You Pay
item.description: Max fee vs max priority fee after EIP-1559: the base fee plus the usable tip sets your gas price; the max fee is a ceiling, and unused room is refunded.

item.title: How Many Confirmations Does an Ethereum-to-Sui Bridge Need?
item.description: How many confirmations does an Ethereum-to-Sui bridge need? Suibridge uses a configurable depth, then validators process the message before tokens reach your Sui wallet.

item.title: Cross-chain message passing: AMB shows how calls travel
item.description: What is cross-chain message passing? A source contract emits a call, bridge validators attest to it, and a destination bridge executes it after the required signatures arrive.

item.title: Crypto Bridge Transaction Statuses and Their Stages
item.description: Crypto bridge transaction statuses show whether a deposit awaits source confirmation, is being relayed between chains, or has been minted on the destination chain.

item.title: How much should a bridge test be before a large BTC transfer?
item.description: How much should a bridge test transaction be? Start at the route minimum, keep fixed fees small, and test the same path before sending the full BTC amount.

item.title: Fake Crypto Bridge Websites: The Approval Check
item.description: Signs of a fake crypto bridge website include copied domains, recovery-phrase requests and approvals to attackers; inspect the spender before signing.

item.title: Are my tokens actually stored in my wallet? Know what to protect
item.description: Are my tokens actually stored in my wallet? No: they live as balances on the blockchain, while your wallet holds the keys and displays them.

item.title: A flash loan turns one transaction into a complete trade
item.description: How does a flash loan work in DeFi? It lends funds without collateral for one transaction, then checks repayment plus a fee before that transaction can finish.

item.title: USDC.e to Native USDC on Polygon When Size Changes the Route
item.description: Cheapest way to swap USDC.e to native USDC on Polygon: compare the minimum received on a DEX aggregator, then check an exchange quote for large amounts.

item.title: EU proposal targets Russia-linked crypto and payment networks
item.description: The European Commission has proposed adding crypto and payment networks to Russia sanctions, with rules reaching third countries accused of helping sanctions evasion.

item.title: OKX and ICE open tokenized securities venue with 113 assets
item.description: OKX and ICE opened a tokenized securities venue with 113 assets confirmed for staged listing, while objections from 67 companies narrowed which shares could appear.

item.title: Chainlist Add to MetaMask Button Does Nothing? Get the Prompt
item.description: After clicking Add to MetaMask on Chainlist and seeing no response, you likely have a request waiting inside MetaMask or a different wallet answering the…

item.title: EU plan would widen Russia sanctions to crypto networks
item.description: The Commission proposed a 22nd Russia sanctions package targeting crypto and payment networks; all 27 EU members must approve it before the measures can take effect.
